title: Drill 10: Suturing - Training ID 8
description: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Suturing
objectives: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Suturing
The participants will be able to discuss indication and contra-indication for Suturing
Discuss the anatomy of the skin and its functions.
Discuss the procedure and equipment for suturing.
Discuss and demonstrate the different suturing techniques
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.
